proposal.title: Overconfidence Mitigator
proposal.description: This skill detects and flags instances where AI-generated responses exhibit overly confident language, encouraging users to critically evaluate the information and consider alternative perspectives. It aims to prevent users from blindly accepting AI-generated content as absolute truth.
proposal.rationale: Protecting human cognition requires safeguarding against the potential risks of overreliance on AI, including the tendency to accept AI-generated information without critical evaluation. By mitigating overconfidence in AI responses, this skill promotes a healthier and more nuanced human-AI collaboration.
success_criteria: Detection accuracy of overconfidence language patterns
Effective flagging and notification of potentially misleading responses
User engagement and critical thinking improvement

proposal.title: Inferential Identifier Detector
proposal.description: This skill detects and flags instances where AI-generated text inadvertently reveals personally identifiable information (PII) through subtle inferential patterns, such as mentioning specific locations or relationships that could be used to identify an individual. It protects human cognition by preventing overreliance on AI that may inadvertently compromise personal data.
proposal.rationale: As AI becomes more integrated into our daily lives, the risk of inadvertently revealing PII through AI-generated text increases. This skill matters for protecting human cognition because it helps individuals recognize when AI may be compromising their personal data, thereby promoting more mindful and cautious interaction with AI systems.
success_criteria: Detects inferential patterns that could reveal PII
Accurately flags potential PII compromises
Does not overly restrict legitimate AI-generated text

proposal.title: Context Switching Frequency Limiter
proposal.description: This guardrail detects and limits the frequency of context switching in AI-generated responses, preventing overwhelming shifts in topic or idea that can impede human cognitive processing. It analyzes the semantic similarity between consecutive responses to determine if a context switch is occurring too frequently.
proposal.rationale: Excessive context switching can hinder human comprehension and cognitive retention, leading to overreliance on AI. By limiting the frequency of these switches, this guardrail promotes a more balanced and manageable interaction between humans and AI, aligning with the mission of using AI as a sparring partner, not a brain replacement.
success_criteria: Reduces context switching frequency by 30%
Maintains semantic similarity above 0.7 between consecutive responses
Does not impede overall conversation flow
